steps: Read the hash-bound page image and every supplied region crop.
Use Rogo vision directly, or a registered optional Surya/Docling adapter when the host exposes it; every provider must normalize to the same sealed response contract.
Write two independent grid-preserving responses with different producer fingerprints.
Bind each response to the exact document, surface, image hash and pass index.
Resume the same broker controller transaction without changing source bytes.
Read only the conflict-manifest-bound cells and their row, period, unit and adjacent-cell context.
Resolve each conflict to a declared source or quarantine it; disposition every conflict exactly once.
Write one reviewed-resolution response bound to the exact manifest and source image.
Resume the same broker controller transaction without replacing the full surface.
Read only the remaining unresolved regions after the full-surface attempt budget is exhausted.
Preserve resolved cells and either resolve or quarantine each remaining cell.
Write the exact hash-bound response artifact named by the task packet.
Resume the same broker controller transaction.
Read only the named period-header cells from the sealed whole-page image and region crops.
Record each complete visible period label with its document, surface, table and column binding; never complete a truncated year from sequence alone.
Omit any still-unreadable column so the controller can quarantine that column while retaining clean sibling periods.
Write broker-period-header-review.json and resume the same controller transaction.
Review every captured analytical table and every annual or partial-period candidate.
Author cell-addressed dispositions broadly while selecting model mappings narrowly.
Preserve guidance, duplicates, supplemental evidence and unlike definitions in separate declared lanes.
Write the crosswalk named by the task packet and resume the same controller transaction.
Read the complete immutable semantic finding set.
Repair crosswalk declarations only; do not alter evidence, schemas, dictionaries or validators.
Disposition all findings in one successor crosswalk bound to the same candidate manifest.
Resume the same controller transaction.
Read the complete pack-compiler finding.
Repair only the crosswalk declaration responsible for the finding.
Preserve the verified bundle and all validator contracts unchanged.
Resume the same controller transaction.
Read the complete hash-bound terminal-recovery analysis after ordinary semantic review is exhausted.
Review every and only candidate proven by the controller to have no mapping, selected model use or mapped source-cell overlap.
Preserve each reviewed candidate as unconsumed evidence quarantine; never infer, rewrite or supply a value.
Write broker-terminal-materiality-review.json and resume the unchanged controller transaction.
Inspect the single aggregate defect and its bound prior task packets.
Repair the earliest responsible controller, response-boundary or deployment-host implementation.
Add a positive regression and a targeted non-vacuous mutation.
Restart from the unchanged source transaction and require checkpoint reuse.
